replicate_shares: replicate secret shares across MPC parties using asynchronous send and receive for 3+ party protocols
mul: multiply two ArithmeticSharedTensors using replicated secret sharing and the ABY3 bilinear protocol
matmul: perform matrix multiplication on two secret-shared tensors using replicated shares and the ABY3 protocol
conv2d: compute a 2D convolution on secret-shared tensors using replicated secret sharing with keyword arguments
square: square a single ArithmeticSharedTensor using replicated secret sharing with the formula x1 squared plus 2 times x1 times x2
truncate: divide an ArithmeticSharedTensor by a constant integer using RSS truncation protocol for 3-party MPC only
AND: compute a bitwise AND on two BinarySharedTensors using replicated secret sharing across MPC parties
